channel.title: K107FM Fife Travel Alerts
channel.description: Live Traffic Scotland updates for Fife

item.title: J5 (Northbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restriction
• The M90 northbound is closed between Junctions 5 and 6 due to essential overnight roadworks. These works also include the closure of the M90 northbound Junction 6 off-slip.
Updated: 19:45

item.title: M90 Ferrytoll (General)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restrictions
• There is currently no access to the M90 heading north at J1b (Ferrytoll) and no exit at J1c (Admiralty Rd.) due to overnight works in the area. The dedicated lane running between these two points are also closed.
Updated: 20:32
